_comment: 1st Battalion's badge catalogue. Starts as a subset of 2nd Battalion's: AM1 runs Rifleman and Machine Gunner as Gun Range variants, AT under Support Weapons, and SL/FTL under Leadership. Every category is kept, even empty ones, so /badge config can add any badge AM2 has -- the editor only offers categories this file defines. The two files are edited independently.

_badgeTypes.tab: levels: [] — no levels at all (Airborne, Radio, JTAC).
_badgeTypes.graded: levels: [...] — the member picks every level they need run, and the instructor runs them in one session.
_badgeTypes.timed: levels: [...] plus timed: true — a timed test where the time achieved decides the level. Nothing is picked at request time; the instructor records the result on completion.

_wip: wip: true hides a badge from the request picker but keeps it in the catalogue, marked Work in Progress. Remove the flag to open it up.
_variants: variants: [...] — a badge run in several forms (e.g. Gun Range by weapon). The instructor picks which one was run when recording the result. Max 25.
_extraTrainers: extraTrainers: ["<@123…>"] — people or roles pinged alongside the instructor roles for that badge only, for badges not every instructor can run. Use <@id> for a person, <@&id> for a role.

badges.name: Gun Range
badges.note: HMG is a Gun Range variant, not its own badge — kept in formerNames so old records still resolve.
